liturgicalName: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
keyVerseDR: "And Jesus advanced in wisdom and age and grace with God and men." (Lk 2:52)

level1.title: Jesus in the Temple
level1.story: When Jesus was 12, His family went to Jerusalem. Jesus stayed behind in the Temple. Mary and Joseph found Him after three days, listening and asking questions.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you obey your parents?
level1.prayer: Holy Family, bless my family. Amen.

activity.title: Find Jesus
activity.intro: Help Mary and Joseph find Jesus in the Temple.

level2.title: Finding Jesus in the Temple
level2.story: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover. When Jesus was twelve, He stayed behind in Jerusalem, and His parents did not know it. After three days they found Him in the Temple, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions. Mary said, "Son, why hast Thou done so to us?" Jesus answered, "Did you not know that I must be about My Father's business?" He went down to Nazareth and was obedient to them, and He grew in wisdom and age and grace.
level2.keyLine: Jesus advanced in wisdom and age and grace.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What did Jesus mean by 'my Father's house'?
How can you grow in wisdom like Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Mary and Joseph, make our home holy. Amen.
